newsitem.title: FINLAND: Insurers, Nokia buoy Helsinki to new record close.
newsitem.headline: Insurers, Nokia buoy Helsinki to new record close.

text.p: Finnish stocks resumed their record-breaking rally on Thursday by active trade in Nokia and financials, and exporters continued to recover as the markka found slightly weaker levels, brokers said.

The HEX general index closed up 2.25 percent at a new 2,785.95 point all-time high, clearly above its previous 2,740.33 record from last week. Volume was a heavy 846 million markka with 43 percent in Nokia.
Insurer Pohjola surged 13.70 markka or over 10 percent to 128.00 on news it would consolidate its fast-growing life insurance business. Turnover was a hefty 67 million markka.
Pohjola's strength drove gains in other financial stocks.
Telecoms major Nokia was firm in lively demand all day, extending gains in late dealings as its ADS opened strongly in New York. It closed at 330.50, up 15.50 markka or almost five percent.

Food group Raisio slumped 21.00 markka or five percent to 403.00 on a report that a researcher has sought a patent for a food additive product based on plant sterol which he said would lower cholestrol levels.
A newspaper report said this was a challenger to Raisio's cholesterol reducing margarine Benecol but Raisio said it did not see it as a threat.
The weaker markka helped exporters' earnings prospects and boosted forestry shares. The forestry sub-index rose 1.32 percent.
